verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is explicitly designed as a terminal AI agent operated via natural-language prompts (debugging, codebase queries, app generation, ReAct loop) per gh-1/2/3/4/23 and docs-3, and community reports confirm real NL-driven agentic usage (comm-1, comm-5, comm-11). However, multiple hands-on reports describe poor navigation, ignored context files, and unreliable interpretation of NL instructions leading to destructive mistakes (comm-13, comm-14, comm-16, comm-17), indicating the natural-language interface works but with significant reliability caveats. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks showing consistent accurate NL command interpretation, and resolution of the reported hallucination/context-ignoring issues.
